plugins.description: Youssef Mostafa's Claude Code skills in one place: planning-board (approval-gated job planning with a live status board), merge-assistant (git merges planned up front: parallel branch analysis, semantic-conflict detection and a tabbed decision review), handoff (verified, cumulative session handoff docs), debug-log-sink (ephemeral localhost log collector with verified cleanup) and sha3bolly (junior-engineer explanation style).
